method.pixels: Native embedded source images, no upsampling for measurement
method.selection: Existing sampled pages; visibly planar grids with multiple rows and enough visible caps. Selection is purposeful, not a random sample of all instructions.
method.centers: Thresholded four-neighbor components; fixed area and bounding-box filters; nearest grid index from visually chosen seed vectors. Three thresholds per image. Ambiguous duplicate indices discarded.
method.validation: Three held-out checkerboard folds and four held-out contiguous column bands; repeat on the intersection of centers present at all thresholds. Affine six parameters versus homography eight.
method.review: All six new annotated images visually reviewed. Initial grid seeds and component filters were corrected where labels drifted or a stud side was mistaken for an inner opening. No points dropped on the basis of residual improvement.
method.features: Solid top caps except Fortnite, where identical hollow-stud openings on both gray edge beams are used; higher colored bricks excluded.
limits: Not an exhaustive or random sample. Minecraft contributes two views of one set.
Perspective-compatible output does not uniquely identify the original rendering pipeline, lens or distance.
Planarity and center estimation remain assumptions; cap/hole centroids are not exact projected geometric centers.
Threshold ranges are sensitivity, not statistical confidence intervals.
Native images range from325 to1198px wide; large assembly view does not imply high-resolution source.
Source images are kept only in the local research folder.

numerical_controls: Known affine and projective grids recover within1e-9px in their applicable models; wrong affine model exceeds1px on projective fixture

equal_pitch_control.method: Two spans of five equal physical stud intervals, measured between matching hollow-stud centers on the same beam; both parallel beams checked at three thresholds.
equal_pitch_control.limits: A direct image-space control, not a recovered camera distance; assumes constant physical pitch and planar beams.
